statuses.reason: The path and body name no object: the inputs are paging, search, archived, status and order_by, or a category name (CreateUpdateCategory). Nothing the request names can be missing, so 404 cannot occur.

components.schemas.FundraisingEvent names no object of the association. id is the event being created, and target_currency_id points at the static currency table, so an unknown currency is an invalid value and gets 400.

The path names no object. The id parameters are list filters (category_id, team_campaign_id, payment_settings_id and association_campaign_target_id on /fundraising-campaigns, category_id on /ecards, ecard_id, payment_settings_id, bank_account_id and currency_id on /ecard-transactions). The only documented behavior for an id filter naming no object is paths./debts.get debt_category_id: 'Another organisation's id matches nothing'. An unknown id therefore returns an empty list, not 404.

properties.reason: components.schemas.FundraisingCampaignList.properties.user__name is described as the 'user unified name' but typed number, so no correct value fits. user__first_name and user__last_name carry the name. PARITY.md lists this contradiction.

components.schemas.FundraisingCampaignList.properties.target_currency__display is a currency display such as 'TRY', typed number. target_currency_id carries the currency. PARITY.md lists this contradiction.

components.schemas.FundraisingTeamCampaignList.properties.target_currency__display is a currency display typed number, while the same field of CreateUpdateFundraisingTeamCampaignResult is a string ('TRY' in its example). target_currency_id carries the currency. PARITY.md lists this contradiction.
